system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> You guys have the worst user interface on pc and mobile. You can't find your way to a specific album or song without having to dig through all the folders. I listen to pretty much the same songs all the time but it still takes like 6 clicks just to play a song."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We totally get that navigating can be tricky. If you have specific suggestions, feel free to share them in our Community for more visibility! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks empathy and helpful tips; needs a more supportive tone and guidance."}
